name: Tuyewera — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Tuyewera from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Tuyewera" but are not part of the Tuyewera entry, which is unchanged.

TUYEWERA
CR 4

The creature that scrabbles up from its grave may have once been human, but it is now an abomination. Its flesh is riddled with worms, its skin split open to reveal decaying organs and bones. Its distended jaw houses a grotesquely elongated tongue that lashes out like a whip. Severed legs leave it crawling on all fours, its movements more beastly than human.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

The tuyewera is a horrifying type of created undead, fashioned through dark rituals to serve as stealthy assassins or agents of vengeance. Invisible by day, it hides in graveyards, waiting for fresh corpses to claim their tongues. Without a master, it becomes a wandering predator, seeking out civilization to terrorize.
